meta.name: pr-lens
meta.description: WHAT: Draws a code change or part of a codebase as an animated architecture or data-flow diagram, on its own or in a pull request. WHEN: asked to diagram, visualise or explain a change or a system, or when a pull request should carry a diagram. KEYWORDS: PR Lens, diagram, architecture, data flow, visualise, visualize, pull request

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把代码改动或系统结构画成动态架构图,随 PR 一起呈现
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果提交 PR 时希望改动一目了然、不用口头解释结构
copy.tagline_en: Draw a code change or system as an animated architecture diagram for your PR
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want reviewers to grasp a change at a glance.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会把代码改动或代码库的某部分画成带动画的架构图和数据流图:先写出一份 JSON 文档,校验后渲染成 SVG,还能推到在线画布给出链接,或把图附到 pull request 描述里。
howto.when: 当你要求画图、可视化或解释某个改动或系统,或希望 pull request 带上图时触发。

say.text: 把这个分支的改动画成架构图
say.note: 读 diff、渲染,并给你一个画布链接

say.text: 给这张流程图补一个队列节点再重新推一次
say.note: 改文档、校验、渲染、推送,链接不变

say.text: 在这次 pull request 的描述里附上架构图
say.note: 用 gh 上传图片并写进 PR 正文

howto.what_en: With PR Lens, Claude draws a code change or part of a codebase as animated architecture and data-flow diagrams: it writes a JSON document, validates and renders it to SVG, pushes it to a canvas with a link, or attaches it to a pull request body.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to diagram, visualise or explain a change or a system, or when a pull request should carry a diagram.

say_en.text: Draw the changes on this branch as an architecture diagram
say_en.note: Reads the diff, renders, returns a canvas link

say_en.text: Add a queue node to this flow and push it again
say_en.note: Edit, validate, render, push; link stays the same

say_en.text: Attach the architecture diagram to this pull request body
say_en.note: Uploads the image with gh into the PR body
